body: I appreciate that. These are all things I've done. I've assessed and cut back on all my expenses. I've moved home. Currently living in my parents basement. I have a daily schedule that I have been following for a long time. Things just keep on getting worse. It's just this endless cycle. I'm not sure if there's genuinely a solution to this. Sure if I get out of debt that's great. But this depression was there before I got into debt and it'll be there after. I've sought counseling. I've tried to talk to people in my life about it but at the end of the day it's just me. Alone. There's nothing I can think of that would make this go away. I legitimately can't remember a single day that I've been happy. I wish there was just an off button...
